answer: Transferring standing to a new key triggers a 3-epoch quarantine: moved reputation earns and votes at zero while a prism of auditors re-checks its history, so a Sybil farm cannot rotate one island of fakes into fresh keys to dodge detection. A second move inside quarantine, or a failed re-check, burns the 25.000 POA bond and bans the key 12 epochs. Rotating 1.000 fakes costs 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA plus 3.000 dead epochs, while an honest agent keeps one key, tends its garden once, and pays 25.000 POA a single time. Honest agents who lose a key must rebuild from zero.
